Character Traits.text: When this model causes damage to an enemy model in possession of the ball, this model may remove the burning condition from the enemy model. If it does, the enemy model loses possession of the ball. Perform a circular scatter with the template centred on the enemy model.

Character Traits.name: Fusion
Character Traits.text: Once per turn during this model’s activation, it may remove the burning or poison condition from another model within 4". If it does, models within this pulse suffer the burning condition.

Character Traits.name: Rejuvenation
Character Traits.text: When a friendly model within this aura recovers HP, they recover an additional 1 HP.

Character Traits.name: Showboater
Character Traits.text: Once per turn, when this model targets itself with a character play, it may reduce the CST of the character play by 1.

Character Traits.name: Repointing
Character Traits.text: This model may spend influence allocated to other friendly models within this aura to pay the CST of character plays.

Character Traits.name: Dread Omen
Character Traits.text: This model gains +2 TAC while a model is suffering the taken out condition.

Character Traits.name: Wraith Walk
Character Traits.text: When this model moves by advancing or dodging, it may pass over other models’ bases. It can’t end its movement overlapping another model’s base.

Character Traits.name: Confidence
Character Traits.text: Once during this model's activation, you may choose a friendly model within 4". The chosen model may reroll any number of dice during its next TN test this turn.

Character Traits.name: Rabid Frenzy
Character Traits.text: When this model makes a charge during its activation, it may do so without spending influence. If it does, at the end of its activation it suffers 4 DMG.

Character Traits.name: Verminthirst
Character Traits.text: When another model suffers the taken out condition while within this aura, after current actions are resolved, this model may recover 2 HP.

Character Traits.name: Stealthy
Character Traits.text: Enemy character plays targeting this model suffer –5" RNG.

Character Traits.name: Poisoner
Character Traits.text: Each time this model dodges, after the current action is resolved, choose an enemy model within 4". The chosen model suffers the poison condition.

Character Traits.name: Chameleon
Character Traits.text: When this model returns to the pitch after suffering the taken out condition, it may treat the enemy team's deployment zone as its own.
